projects.title: Go: Outsmart the AI
projects.short_description: Play 9×9 Go against a Monte Carlo AI and learn why the game transformed artificial intelligence.
projects.long_description: A playable strategy game and interactive AI lesson by Mr. Scandrett. Choose an AI strength, request tactical hints, preview territory, undo a round, and discover how Monte Carlo search paved the way from Deep Blue to AlphaGo.
